verdict.rationale: Insomnia's spec design view auto-lints OpenAPI specs and shows errors inline (insomnia-docs-17), and the Inso CLI supports `inso lint spec` to fail CI builds on errors (insomnia-docs-49/59), which covers basic spec linting and CI governance gating. However, there is no evidence of configurable style/governance rulesets (e.g., custom rule definitions, style guides, or org-wide policy enforcement) beyond basic OpenAPI validation. Missing for 10: evidence of custom/configurable lint rulesets, style-guide enforcement, or governance policy configuration beyond default OpenAPI error checking.
